key_point: Why Metal Gear is about hiding
title: Why Metal Gear is about hiding
caption: Metal Gear became a stealth game because the hardware couldn't handle combat. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #metalgear #konami

instagram.caption:
Metal Gear was supposed to be a combat game, but the MSX2 computer could not show many enemies or bullets on screen at once.

Hideo Kojima turned the limit into the idea: instead of fighting soldiers, you sneak past them and stay hidden.

That decision launched one of gaming's biggest series and the whole stealth genre. A hardware problem became a masterpiece.

Stealth or guns blazing?
